description: Every litellm_* Prometheus metric the LiteLLM proxy emits, one panel per metric family, grouped by theme.

panels.description: Total number of requests made to the proxy server - track number of client side requests
panels.title: litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric rate

panels.description: Total number of failed responses from proxy - the client did not get a success response from litellm proxy
panels.title: litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric rate

panels.description: deprecated - use litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric. Total number of LLM calls to litellm - track total per API Key, team, user
panels.title: litellm_requests_metric rate

panels.description: deprecated - use litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric
panels.title: litellm_llm_api_failed_requests_metric rate

panels.description: Number of HTTP requests currently in-flight on this uvicorn worker
panels.title: litellm_in_flight_requests

panels.description: Time (seconds) from request arrival at the proxy to the start of pre-call processing -- includes authentication and any ASGI-level queueing
panels.title: litellm_request_queue_time_seconds p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Requests admitted by this worker (needs the admission control middleware enabled)
panels.title: litellm_admission_admitted_requests

panels.description: Requests queued by this worker (needs the admission control middleware enabled)
panels.title: litellm_admission_queued_requests

panels.description: Requests rejected by this worker (needs the admission control middleware enabled)
panels.title: litellm_admission_rejected_requests rate

panels.description: End-to-end latency (seconds) for a request to LiteLLM Proxy Server, from the moment the request reached the proxy through the end of processing -- includes authentication, pre-call hooks, the LLM API call, and post-call processing
panels.title: litellm_request_total_latency_metric p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Total latency (seconds) for a models LLM API call
panels.title: litellm_llm_api_latency_metric p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Time to first token for a models LLM API call
panels.title: litellm_llm_api_time_to_first_token_metric p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Latency overhead (milliseconds) added by LiteLLM processing
panels.title: litellm_overhead_latency_metric p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Total internal latency (seconds) added by LiteLLM, including pre/post-call guardrails (excludes the LLM API call)
panels.title: litellm_overhead_with_guardrails_latency_metric p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: LLM Deployment Analytics - Latency per output token
panels.title: litellm_deployment_latency_per_output_token p50 / p95 / p99

panels.description: Total spend on LLM requests
panels.title: litellm_spend_metric rate

panels.description: Total number of input + output tokens from LLM requests

panels.description: Total number of input tokens from LLM requests

panels.description: Number of images generated, from the image generation response
